title: Safe triangle of insertion
view: The patient's left lateral chest, supine, arm abducted, head toward the upper right (the approved serratus_patient_position painting, reused).
teachingPoint: Insert within the triangle bounded by pectoralis major, latissimus dorsi, the nipple level and the axilla: the 4th-5th space on the mid-axillary line.
claims: Triangle borders: lateral border of pectoralis major, anterior border of latissimus dorsi, a line at the horizontal level of the nipple, apex at the axilla (record).
Insertion at the 4th-5th intercostal space, mid-axillary line, just above the nipple-level base (record).
Incision drawn along the rib (record: incise parallel to the rib).
Muscle borders traced from the folds visible on the painting; the record names no side, and this is the shipped left-side painting.
Labels: Pectoralis major (lateral border), Latissimus dorsi (anterior border), Nipple level, Axilla, 4th-5th space, mid-axillary line.

geometry.why: the mid-axillary line runs through the triangle
the triangle lies caudal to the axilla (head to the right)
